en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who says to his wife, ‘You are free from me’, or ‘disavowed from me’, or ‘prohibited’’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is not with anything’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a man who says to his wife, ‘You from my side are free, cleared and severed’ or ‘you are unlawful.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘It does not have any valid effect.’”
